@tthvo: This pull request explicitly references no jira issue.

<details>

In response to [this](https://github.com/openshift/installer/pull/10490):

>Add debug logging of the full openshift-install command invocation to `.openshift_install.log`.
>
>**Note**: we use `sync.Once` to ensure the command and version info are logged exactly once, even when `SetupFileHook` is called multiple times during execution (e.g., create cluster calls it twice).
>
>This is quite helpful to identify the command that users run during debugging. Additionally, it can help clearly identify which log section belongs to which invoked command.

If you have questions or suggestions related to my behavior, please file an issue against the [openshift-eng/jira-lifecycle-plugin](https://github.com/openshift-eng/jira-lifecycle-plugin/issues/new) repository.
</details>

## Walkthrough Ensure startup logging for the invoked `openshift-install` command (including redacted CLI args and version/commit) runs only once by guarding it with a package-level `sync.Once` and adding argument redaction logic. ## Changes |Cohort / File(s)|Summary| |---|---| |**Logging & CLI redaction**
`cmd/openshift-install/command/log.go`|Added `logCmdOnce sync.Once` and `redactCommandArgs(args []string) []string`. Wrapped startup logging (command line, `version.String()`, `version.Commit`) in a `sync.Once` guard; replaced unconditional version logging. Handles redaction for `--key` and `--master` in both `--flag value` and `--flag=value` forms. Imports updated to include `sync`.| ## Estimated code review effort 🎯 2 (Simple) | ⏱️ ~10 minutes
✨ Finishing Touches
🧪 Generate unit tests (beta) - [ ] Create PR with unit tests

```
- Around line 112-113: The log call writes raw os.Args into persistent
.openshift_install.log, which can leak secrets; add a helper (e.g.,
redactCommandArgs) and call it prior to logging so that known sensitive flags
(refer to flags like "--key", "--password", "--token", "--secret",
"--pull-secret", "--skip-password-print" if present) have their values replaced
or masked before invoking logrus.Debugf("Running: %s", ...). Implement
redactCommandArgs(args []string) to copy and mutate the slice (handle both
"--flag value" and "--flag=value" forms) and use redactCommandArgs(os.Args) in
place of os.Args when logging the command.
```
